headline: Electricity prices in July: Lithuanians pay 5 times more for electricity than Finns
summary: The average July electricity price on the exchange fell 20% to 75.63 euros per megawatt-hour, cheaper than June. Lithuanians still pay about five times more for electricity than Finns, according to the report.
why: Wholesale power prices reflect generation costs and grid links, affecting utility margins and industrial energy costs in the Baltic region.
